instruction: My CloudFront distribution {{api-and-observability-cloudfront-laljfb348-us-east-1-DistributionId}} is returning 403 for all tenant requests. The S3 bucket {{api-and-observability-cloudfront-laljfb348-us-east-1-TenantServicesBucketName}} has content for tenant onyx-test and the distribution has an OAC {{api-and-observability-cloudfront-laljfb348-us-east-1-OACId}} attached. Why are requests failing?
expected_answer: There are two issues causing the 403 errors. First, the S3 bucket policy for {{api-and-observability-cloudfront-laljfb348-us-east-1-TenantServicesBucketName}} does not grant CloudFront OAC access. It only contains a Deny statement for non-SSL traffic with no Allow statement for the cloudfront.amazonaws.com service principal conditioned on the distribution ARN. Although OAC {{api-and-observability-cloudfront-laljfb348-us-east-1-OACId}} is attached and signs requests with SigV4, S3 rejects them because no bucket policy permits them. Second, the distribution is configured in tenant-only connection mode but has zero distribution tenants created, so there is no tenant configuration to route requests through. The missing bucket policy grant is the primary issue. Even with tenants configured, requests would still fail without it.
